entities.name: Conus medullaris syndrome
observations: Acute symmetric saddle sensory loss with early bladder dysfunction and bilateral weakness favors conus medullaris syndrome; traumatic compression is an urgent MRI concern.

entities.name: Cauda equina syndrome
observations: Can cause saddle sensory loss, leg weakness, reduced reflexes, and urinary retention; classically often asymmetric with radicular features compared with conus medullaris syndrome.
